name: hyx-checkin
description: Surge module for daily check-in on hyxware.com (HyxAPI): captures the web session once, renews it with the refresh cookie, checks in on a cron schedule and reports balance in a panel.

scripts.verify: npm run validate && node --check src/hyx_checkin.js && node scripts/build-hyx.js --check && node scripts/test-hyx-checkin.js
